cause: The existing waiter continued only while inspect_process returned live. A dying runner can legitimately be ambiguous when its start identity was observed but getpgid then loses the PID, or the group inventory is inconclusive. Ambiguous is not confirmed dead. The test exited its waiter on that intermediate classification, then asserted dead. The product classifier correctly fails closed and is unchanged.
